title: Fleet runway & token unit-econ sensitivity matrix
summary: Interactive planning sheet for mapping GPU-hour burn to $/1M tokens by region and workload. Includes baseline assumptions, sensitivity bands for utilization (50-95%), spot share, and prioritized mitigation actions to extend runway. Designed to be a pragmatic tool for infra PMs and SREs to evaluate short-term runway and near-term capacity tradeoffs.
content:
Purpose:
- Provide a quick matrix that converts GPU-hour commitments and real-world utilization profiles into $/1M tokens across regions and workload classes.
- Surface sensitivity to three levers: average utilization, spot/preemptible mix, and effective tokens-per-GPU-hour (depends on model family & batching).
- Produce a set of recommended actions (low effort -> high impact) to buy time or reduce unit cost if runway shrinks.

Context / why this differs from existing sheets:
- Focused on token economics per workload bucket (low-latency chat, medium-latency assistant, high-throughput embeddings) rather than only fleet-level projections.
- Explicitly models preemptible/spot behavior as a stochastic multiplier on usable GPU-hours and latency SLO hit rate.
- Lightweight, meant for quick scenario play during cross-functional runway reviews.

Key baseline assumptions (editable cells):
- GPU SKUs modeled: A100-40 (dense), A10G (cost-efficient), H100-80 (high perf)
- Nominal hourly list prices (after discounts): A100-40: $3.20/hr, A10G: $1.10/hr, H100-80: $6.50/hr
- Effective tokens per GPU-hour (at baseline batching/kv-cache):
  - Low-latency-chat (avg seq 128, p50): A100-40: 70M tokens/hr, A10G: 24M tokens/hr, H100-80: 160M tokens/hr
  - Assistant (avg seq 512): A100-40: 22M, A10G: 7.5M, H100-80: 48M
  - Embeddings (batch 2048): A100-40: 900M, A10G: 320M, H100-80: 1.8B
- Baseline utilization bands to model: 50%, 70%, 85%, 95%
- Spot preemption cost multipliers: spot price = 0.35 * on-demand; effective usable fraction with 24hr window = 0.70 (i.e., we lose ~30% of spot GPU-hours to preemption + scheduling gaps)
- Overhead reserve (autoscale buffer & infra ops) = 6% of capacity

Core matrix (example rows; sheet should allow pivoting):
- Columns: region, gpu_sku, on_demand_hourly_cost, spot_hourly_cost, baseline_tokens_per_hour (by workload bucket), utilization, spot_share, effective_gpu_hours, tokens_per_1M_cost 
- Formula notes (verbatim text for copy):
  - effective_gpu_hours = committed_gpu_hours * utilization * (1 - overhead_reserve) * (1 - spot_share * spot_loss_fraction)
  - blended_hourly_cost = on_demand_cost * (1 - spot_share) + spot_cost * spot_share
  - tokens_per_$1 = (effective_tokens_per_hour / blended_hourly_cost) / 1,000,000  -> tokens per $1M: tokens_per_$1 * 1,000,000 (show as $/1M = 1 / tokens_per_$1 * 1,000,000)

Sample scenario snapshot (US-West-2 / A100-40 / Assistant workload):
- Committed capacity: 400 GPU-hours/day (12,000 GPU-hours/month)
- utilization: 70% -> effective_gpu_hours = 12,000 * 0.7 * 0.94 * (1 - 0.25*0.30) = ~7,500 usable hrs/month (spot_share = 25%, spot_loss_fraction=0.30)
- baseline tokens/hr for assistant on A100-40 = 22M -> monthly tokens = 7,500 * 22M = 165B tokens/month
- blended hourly cost = $3.20 * 0.75 + ($3.20*0.35) * 0.25 = $2.40 + $0.28 = $2.68/hr (spot priced at 35% of on-demand)
- monthly cost = 12,000 * $2.68 = $32,160 -> $/1M tokens = $32,160 / 165,000 = $0.195 per 1k tokens => $195 per 1M tokens (show final as $/1M = $195)

Sensitivity bands to compute in sheet (produce three outputs for each scenario):
- unit_cost_best_case: utilization=95%, spot_share=50%, spot_loss_fraction=0.20
- unit_cost_base_case: utilization=70%, spot_share=30%, spot_loss_fraction=0.30
- unit_cost_worst_case: utilization=50%, spot_share=10%, spot_loss_fraction=0.40 (i.e., poor scale & low spot tolerance)

Runway table (example):
- Inputs: committed_monthly_cost, monthly_burn_rate_from_tokens (calculated), runway_months = committed_remaining_balance / monthly_burn_cost
- Example: committed credits $500k, projected monthly committed billing under base_case $320k -> runway = 1.56 months.
- Show mitigations with estimated delta to monthly burn:
  - Increase spot_share by 20pp (reduce blended cost by ~12%): delta runway +0.2 months
  - Convert 30% of A100-40 workload to A10G + quantization (reduces effective cost per token by ~28% for batched workloads): delta runway +0.6 months
  - Aggressive prefix caching (reduce tokens-per-request by 8% for assistant workloads): delta runway +0.15 months

Operational flags to surface per-region in sheet (checkboxes / Y/N fields):
- risk: spot-prone region (yes/no)
- SLO-sensitivity: high | medium | low (manual tag)
- migration-ease: quick / medium / hard (notes about data locality, egress costs, compliance)

Recommended immediate actions (prioritized):
1) Run a 7-day live split test of spot_share increase (+15pp) on non-critical embedding queues; surface preemption-induced retry cost. Owner: SRE. Impact estimate: -10% monthly burn.
2) Instrument tokens-per-GPU-hour per model variant in telemetry (per route/model) to remove guesswork for effective tokens/hr. Owner: Observability. Timeline: 2 weeks.
3) Create a one-page decision tree in console that maps customer workloads to recommended default SKUs and batching configs (small engineering effort, large cost upside). Owner: Product.

Open questions / TODOs (quick list):
- Reconcile actual cloud invoice blended rate per region with our baseline price table (patch sheet with real invoice rows).
- Validate spot_loss_fraction empirically per region & provider (we currently use a 30% proxy).
- Add per-model KV cache hit-rate parametrization to tokens/hr estimation (big lever for assistant workloads).

Appendix: quick lookup table (example values to paste into sheet)
- Regions: us-west-2, us-east-1, eu-west-1, ap-northeast-1
- A100-40 on-demand: us-west-2 $3.20, us-east-1 $3.10, eu-west-1 $3.40, ap-northeast-1 $3.80
- A100-40 spot: multiply by 0.35
- A10G on-demand: us-west-2 $1.10, us-east-1 $1.05, eu-west-1 $1.20, ap-northeast-1 $1.35
- H100-80 on-demand: us-west-2 $6.50, us-east-1 $6.30, eu-west-1 $6.80, ap-northeast-1 $7.40

How to use this file in a meeting:
- Load baseline table, toggle to base_case. Present $/1M tokens per workload and region as a heatmap.
- Flip to worst_case and show which regions move above our alert threshold ($/1M > $300 for assistant workloads).
- Walk prioritized mitigations and estimate runway change live.

Notes on provenance:
- Numbers are conservative proxies derived from infra telemetry snapshots (Nov–Dec 2024) and cloud price lists. Replace with live billing & telemetry for final decisions.
